groups.name: c-backend
groups.notes: Typed C99 lowering from checked core, explicit destinations, simultaneous tail rebinding, bounded cells and stack. ByteOutput remains an external dependency.
groups.note: Structural preflight only: no ratings or request bodies. A truncated unit cannot pass (Anticipation/Payoff unavailable); a unit without complete role context is held to the leading targets; an unavailable required composition prevents qualification. Project mode has no declared group, as in a live run; single-file groups are reported for planning explicit groups.

note: Qualification covers exactly the selected manifest groups, each with its own declaration and composition obligations. Shared declarations count once per group. Local collaborators retain the existing bounded context and closure checks. Structural preflight is not a style rating or semantic acceptance.
